theme.rationale: Light theme is preferable for a lively adventure park CRM that will likely be used in daylight/outdoors by staff, providing better visibility and matching the energetic, vibrant vibe.

headings.rationale: Nunito provides a rounded, friendly, and playful look suitable for an adventure park without losing readability.

typography.setup_instruction: Add Google fonts Nunito in public/index.html and update tailwind.config.js theme.fontFamily.sans

colors.rationale: Perfect for a funland adventure park, communicating energy, approachability, and excitement.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: High Density Grid for CRM mixed with generous padding for interactive elements to suit mobile devices.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous spacing. Use p-4 to p-8 for containers. Buttons should have ample touch targets for staff mobile usage.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Subtle roundness, max 12px border-radius (rounded-xl) for cards to maintain structural CRM look while being friendly. Rounded-full for buttons.

surface_strategies.cards: Neumorphism mix: Flat white background (bg-card), 1px subtle border (border-border), with a soft shadow (shadow-sm). On hover: shadow-md and slightly lift (-translate-y-1).
surface_strategies.headers: Solid surface with a subtle bottom border to prevent visual refraction of data.

component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary CTAs. Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md) for secondary actions like table row edits. Explicit hover states (e.g. hover:bg-primary/90).
component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn UI forms. Inputs should have bg-white, soft border, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-secondary.
component_instructions.tables: Shadcn UI table. Clean, flat rows, zebra striping optional. Actions column right-aligned.
component_instructions.toasts: Use Sonner for notifications (e.g., 'Bill Generated', 'Attendance Logged').

motion.hover_states: All buttons, links, and cards must have transition-transform or transition-colors.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in for list items and table rows.
motion.feedback: Micro-interactions on buttons (scale down slightly on active/click).

amusement_park_hero.description: Colorful ferris wheel and rides, used for login background or marketing dashboard header.

park_aerial_view.description: Aerial view of amusement park, useful for dashboard welcome widget.

arcade_games.description: Arcade games room, suitable as a thumbnail for games catalog.

happy_employee_1.description: Smiling employee portrait, used for staff attendance or profile.

icons_and_assets.rationale: Already installed, clean and versatile for dense dashboards.
icons_and_assets.usage: Use icons for sidebar nav, table actions, and KPI cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast against background. Text over Primary (#FFB703) should be dark foreground.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center align the App container. No generic centered layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Prevent cramped designs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Do not apply universal 'transition: all', target specific properties.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components from src/components/ui.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-button').
Always explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
Avoid fully transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns.

specific_screens_guidelines.login: Split screen or modal over a blurred park image. Vibrant logo/branding. Role selection (Manager vs Staff).
specific_screens_guidelines.dashboard: Mobile-first layout. Top row: Quick actions (New Visit, Add Inquiry). Next row: KPI cards (Today's Revenue, Footfall, Active Packages).
specific_screens_guidelines.billing_entry: Searchable games/packages list with '+' button. Selected items form a 'cart' view. Grand total with GST toggle. Big 'Generate Bill' button.
specific_screens_guidelines.marketing_composer: Card with text area, image upload stub, and 'Draft for Instagram/Facebook' or 'Broadcast WhatsApp' buttons.
specific_screens_guidelines.attendance: Simple 'Check In' / 'Check Out' large buttons with current time. List of recent punches.
